username.description: Unique login name (e.g., `alice`). Must match the system username and filename.

real_name.description: User’s full display name (e.g., `Alice Smith`). Shown in login manager and user lists.

icon_path.description: Absolute path to the user’s avatar image (PNG or XPM). Usually `/var/lib/AccountsService/icons/<username>`.

password_hint.description: Optional hint shown when password entry is focused. Leave blank to hide.

password_mode.description: Deprecated. Ignored by modern accountsservice. Keep empty.

language.description: Locale for the user (e.g., `en_US.UTF-8`, `de_DE`). Blank uses system locale.

session.description: Default desktop session (e.g., `gnome`, `plasma`, `xfce`). Blank defaults to system session.

login_frequency.description: How often the user appears in the login list: `never`, `recent`, or `always`.

last_login.description: Unix timestamp of last login. Auto-updated; set to 0 to reset.

login_failed.description: Count of recent failed login attempts. Auto-updated.

automatic_login.description: Enable automatic login on boot (skips password prompt). Insecure on multi-user systems.

automatic_login_while_locked.description: Allow auto-login even after locking (e.g., when resuming from suspend). Highly discouraged.

password_expiry.description: Unix timestamp when password expires (0 = no expiry). Requires PAM module `pam_unix`.

password_changed.description: Unix timestamp when password was last changed. Auto-updated.

system_account.description: Mark as a system account (UID < 1000). Hides user from greeter and UI tools.

custom_fields.description: Additional key-value pairs for custom integration (e.g., PolicyKit or LDAP extensions).

key.description: Field name (e.g., `PolicyKitIdentity`). Must be valid INI key format.
